R7BG-grouse-atv-0001.name: 630 m NW of Kahntah River
R7BG-grouse-atv-0001.pressureWhy: No town, pavement or rec site within 1 km and not behind a closure (estimate).
R7BG-grouse-atv-0001.parkWhat: where the truck road ends (unnamed gravel road); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle)

evidence.t: 100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (BWBS, CWH, ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS, SBPS, SBS).
4 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.
3 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.
Black bear: young cutblocks and burns grow berries in late summer and fall (Tip).

plan: Drive: from Kahntah, about 125 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 57.52003, -120.49816, where the truck road ends (unnamed gravel road); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle). Map links below.
Walk 490 m to the start. Ride: the Fontas Rd stretch, 4.8 km one way. About 96 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-47, Region 7B. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-16, closures 2026-10-16.
R7BG-grouse-atv-0001.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 7-47: about 266 hunter days a year for all big game (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.03 days per square km, bottom third of BC MUs; access: average access. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

tags.label: Good solo
tags.why: Short pack out: 0.5 km and about 0 m of climb from the parking (Tip). Cell coverage is not in the data: leave a trip plan and carry SOS or a satellite messenger (lesson: Bush safety).
